Policy requires such decisions to be routed to pricing_desk for review.","policy_evidence_id":"PRC-2025.1§8"}],"decision":"accept_request","explanation":"Policy PRC-2025.1 applies because the decision date of 2026-03-31 falls inside its effective window (2025-01-01 inclusive to 2026-04-01 exclusive). The merchant states it wants 2.39% + $0.20; this request is unverified. Mid-size list pricing is 2.40% + $0.20.

The merchant reports $720,000 in monthly volume across 14,400 transactions. No merchant-specific cost data is available, so the policy default cost basis of 1.90% + $0.10 applies. On that basis, the requested price produces monthly revenue of $20,088 and cost of $15,120. Gross profit is $4,968, a gross margin of 24.73%. This meets the 24% minimum for mid-size merchants. No promotion applies.

The discount against list revenue ($20,160) is 0.36%. That is well below the 15% threshold that would require regional_pricing_manager approval. Monthly volume is below $5,000,000, so deal_desk approval is not needed. No strategic exception is involved, so cfo_delegate approval is not needed.

We recommend accepting the request. Because default costs were used, the decision must be routed to pricing_desk for review. The margin headroom is thin, at about 0.73 percentage points above the minimum.
